_comment_purpose: DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 config for Phase 3.5 CPT of Gemma-2-27B on 8xA100 80GB (with CPU optimizer offload)
_comment_memory: 27B params in bf16 = 54GB weights, sharded across 8 GPUs = ~7GB weights/GPU. Optimizer states (AdamW: 8 bytes/param * 27B = 216GB) offloaded to CPU. Gradients sharded = ~7GB/GPU. Plus activations ~30GB/GPU with grad checkpointing + partition. Total: ~44GB/GPU peak, fits in 80GB. CPU RAM required: 216GB+ (available: 1.9TB).
